scope: Fixed deterministic constructor/evaluator and corruption assertions only. No scientific census, solver, benchmark, cost measurement, random trial or fixture discovery.
curve_premise: The named small primes are literal mathematical fixtures; APIs state p prime as input premise, without claiming general primality certification.

chart_fixtures.expected: valid common A/B root and target overlap
valid U=X^5; A=X^3+2,B=3; no factorial inverse/trace-rank alias
valid wrapped support, B=0, A=X^2(X-4), signed target subtraction
valid U=X^2, A=2X+4,B=1; norm support must add r=4 outside interval
valid h=X-3, norm multiplicity2 and one signed target subtraction

mandatory_mutations: Replace n^k by n; valid repeated fixture must demonstrate this incorrect predicate rejects it.
Replace positive integer multiplicity5 by field trace0; factor certificate rejects.
Drop finite target r from norm support in target_outside_interval; signed degree/identity check rejects.
Subtract R rather than -R in a non-two-torsion fixture; group/signed residual check rejects.
Collapse both signs or remove one common-factor contribution; complete divisor check rejects.
Treat two-torsion as two distinct signs; multiplicity/group check rejects.
For E/F5 a1,b1,U=(X-1)^2,t0,s1,e0=1, quotient interval passes but rational ordinate f(1)=3 fails; do not drop rationality on common A/B roots.

Mutate idempotent coefficient, norm coefficient, U leading coefficient, factor multiplicity, target ordinate, and late malformed canonical field/mask items; reject the appropriate independent obligation.
test_oracle: Independent direct field equations/group addition on the listed point tuples, exact polynomial multiplication and local Hasse series. No exhaustive curve/tuple/field search or chart enumeration.
accounting: Descriptive algorithm-event counts and symbolic field-operation bounds only, no measured timing comparison or cross-unit work sum. Charge supplied-root validation and any explicit square-root/nonresidue inputs; no hidden field scan.
failure_semantics: Retain every failure/source snapshot/correction; stop on fixed scope/cap failure. Four attempts is a bounded implementation correction allowance; no tuning scientific parameters. Once archived, additive correction only.
